brief: The 6-step content growth loop that took us from 0 to 100K followers in 90 days. Each step explained with the actual tools.

slots.title: 1. Research, the trend hunter
slots.body: We start every post by asking Perplexity to surface the top-performing hooks in our niche from the last 48 hours. No guessing.

slots.title: 2. Script, the blueprint
slots.body: We write every caption and CTA inside a Notion database that links the hook to the offer. One source of truth.

slots.title: 3. Design, the scroll stopper
slots.body: Figma templates let us batch 30 thumbnails in one session. Every element is pinned to a 3x3 grid so the hook never gets cropped.

slots.title: 4. Schedule, the content calendar
slots.body: Airtable holds the publish dates, platforms, and asset links. We filter by status so the pipeline stays visible to the whole team.

slots.title: 5. Distribute, the automation wiring
slots.body: Zapier pushes new posts from Airtable to LinkedIn, X, and Instagram the moment the status changes to Live. Zero manual uploads.

slots.title: 6. Engage, the feedback loop
slots.body: We drop every new post into a private Discord channel where the team leaves comments within the first 10 minutes. Algorithmic velocity starts here.
